pages.text: Raw Radiant Quartz is an unrefined magical crystal that makes up the basis of all of Arcane Archives. It is primarily a crafting component.$(br2)Raw Radiant Quartz can be used to convert a chest to a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radiantchest)Radiant Chest$(/l).$(br2)Raw Radiant Quartz can be used to convert a crafting table into a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radiantcraftingtable)Radiant Crafting Table$(/l).
Raw Radiant Quartz can be used to create $(l:arcanearchives:items/sliveroflight)Slivers of Light$(/l) by bashing a piece against another block.

Astral Sorcery Lightwell When placed in a Lightwell with access to the sky, Raw Radiant Quartz creates Liquid Starlight over time. Compared to Aquamarine, its production rate is significantly lower, but is much more resistant to shattering.

Raw Radiant Quartz is created over time on top of a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radiantresonator)Radiant Resonator$(/l) in the form of a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/rawquartzcluster)Raw Quartz Cluster$(/l).
Raw Radiant Quartz can also be compressed into a storage block. Blocks of Raw Radiant Quartz are a light source.$(br2)Blocks of Raw Radiant Quartz can be crafted conventionally.
